category_edits.rationale: Expand each SASRec block's feed-forward intermediate width to four times the hidden dimension to increase nonlinear capacity while preserving ReLU, dropout, residual paths, attention, embeddings, scoring, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports SASRec from train.py, so it reconstructs the widened architecture automatically.

change_summary: Widen SASRec feed-forward layers to hidden → 4×hidden → hidden for all four category models, with predictor architecture consistency preserved through its existing train.py import.
